{{Quote|All these Wookiees are dead. Move to the east.|An AT-RT driver|<ref name="SWE3" />}}
'''AT-RT drivers''', also known as '''AT-RT clone pilots''', were elite [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilots]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] that specialized in ground [[Scout/Legends|reconnaissance]] and operating the bipedal [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transport]], which they were named after. Known for their modified [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|clone armor]] and unique [[Helmet/Legends|helmets]], AT-RT drivers fought in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Description==
===Overview===
The [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] AT-RT drivers,<ref name="Hasbro ATRT driver">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (toy line)|pack=#54: AT-RT Driver|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/ROTS0554atrtdriver.asp}}</ref> also known as AT-RT clone pilots, were specialized [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilots]] that received extensive training in [[Scout/Legends|scouting]], [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifle]] [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooting]], and operating the [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transport]], a type of bipedal reconnaissance [[Walker/Legends|walker]] manufactured by [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] and the vehicle they were named after. Considered elite [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]],<ref name="Vehicles 30" /> AT-RT drivers also received additional conditioning for [[Swamp/Legends|swampy]] and humid environments.<ref name="Tin ATRT">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|packtype=Commemorative Tin Collection|pack=Star Wars: Episode III - Revenge of the Sith (Mace Windu, Yoda, Anakin Skywalker, AT-RT Driver)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TACtinepisodeiIII.asp}}</ref>

[[File:212th_AT-RT.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The 212th Attack Battalion was known to use AT-RT drivers.]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], clone AT-RT drivers often participated in reconnaissance and infantry support operations, helping support clone recon patrols in locations with dangerous jungle terrain,<ref name="Vehicles 30" /> as the AT-RT gave them more mobility and visibility than a standard foot soldier.<ref name="AT-RT assault squad">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|packtype=Battle Pack|pack=AT-RT Assault Squad|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/tacBPassault.asp}}</ref> The Republic also used AT-RT drivers as a means to provide constant situation reports and feed information back to [[Forward Command Center/Legends|Forward Command Centers]]. Furthermore, following battles, AT-RT pilots were used to survey battlefields in order to direct [[Clone medic/Legends|clone trooper medics]] to wounded [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]], to recover equipment, take prisoners, and to destroy any remaining [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]]. While AT-RT [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] were known for their usage of the AT-RT, they still participated in scouting operations without their walkers.<ref name="Vehicles 30" />

Several units fielded AT-RT drivers, including the [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Legion]]—whose drivers were renowned for being some of the best,<ref name="Vehicles 30" /> [[Green Company/Legends|Green Company]],<ref name="CW:TGoD" /> the [[91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps/Legends|91st Mobile Reconnaissance Corps]],<ref name="91st ATRT">{{PocketModel|set=Order 66|cardname=91st Recon Corps AT-RT|link=http://www.swpocketmodels.com/images/shipo01c.jpg}}</ref> [[Lightning Squadron/Legends|Lightning Squadron]],<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> the [[212th Attack Battalion/Legends|212th Attack Battalion]],<ref name="212th ATRT" /> and the [[442nd Siege Battalion/Legends|442nd Siege Battalion]].<ref name="442nd ATRT">{{PocketModel|set=Order 66|cardname=442nd Siege Battalion AT-RT|link=https://www.starwars-universe.com/images/multimedia/Images/CCG%20-%20TCG/Pocketmodels/03-Order_66/ships/ship-01a.jpg}}</ref>

===Equipment and armor===
[[File:Epic_Battles.jpg|thumb|right|250px|ARC heavy gunners used modified AT-RT driver armor during the Clone Wars.]]
AT-RT drivers wore modified [[Clone trooper armor/Legends|clone trooper armor]] with smaller shoulder pads and a specialized [[Helmet/Legends|helmet]]. Visually distinct from the standard clone helmet, the AT-RT driver's helmet featured a protruding, enhanced [[Long-range comlink/Legends|long-range comlink]], allowing the pilot to operate away from their AT-RT. While the standard clone helmet featured a singular T-shaped visor, the AT-RT driver's helmet had two visors instead, one for each [[Eye/Legends|eye]].<ref name="Vehicles 30" />

AT-RT drivers acting as scouts occasionally wore [[Life-form scanner/Legends|lifeform scanners]] strapped to their chest plates. The [[Sensor/Legends|scanners]] had a circular, metallic appearance, with a [[Color/Legends|red]] sensor in the middle.<ref name="Vehicles 30" /> Standard driver armor was white,<ref name="Tin ATRT" /><ref name="Titanium ATRT">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Titanium Series|pack=AT-RT|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/swts06atrt.asp}}</ref> but could be customized to denote unit affiliation.<ref name="RotS:VD">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> The 212th Attack Battalion's AT-RT drivers used orange markings,<ref name="212th ATRT" /> while the 41st Elite Legion's drivers used green and brown camouflage markings on their armor.<ref name="Vehicles 30" /> [[Advanced Recon Commando heavy gunner]]s used modified AT-RT driver armor to aid in operating their [[Reciprocating quad blaster cannon/Legends|reciprocating quad blasters]].<ref name="Quad blaster">{{DB|technology|cipquad|Reciprocating Quad Blaster (Cip-Quad)}}</ref>

===Vehicles and weapons===
[[File:ATRTdriver-TROSPromoYT.png|thumb|left|220px|An AT-RT driver piloting an AT-RT.]]
As their name implied, AT-RT drivers used the All Terrain Recon Transport as their primary vehicle and weapon of choice during the Clone Wars. While the AT-RT was their primary vehicle,<ref name="Vehicles 30" /> they also made use of other vehicles, such as the [[TX-130 Saber-class fighter tank/Legends|Republic fighter tank]].<ref name="TX130">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Movie Heroes|pack=Republic Fighter Tank|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/republic_fighter_tank_movie_heroes_star_wars_vehicle_hasbro.asp}}</ref> 

While operating outside of their AT-RTs, drivers used a wide variety of other [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] during war. Their main weapons included the [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]] and the [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]], which could be stowed away at the back of the AT-RT, and a small stock of<ref name="Vehicles 30" /> [[V-1 thermal detonator]]s.<ref name="GGAR">{{InsiderCite|84|Guide to the Grand Army of the Republic}}</ref> AT-RT pilots developed a familiarity with [[Sniper/Legends|sniper]] [[Rifle/Legends|rifles]] during their training as scouts, and would often use the [[DC-15x sniper rifle/Legends|DC-15x sniper rifle]] during their missions. Certain AT-RT drivers also used heavier weapons, including the [[PLX-1/Legends|PLX-1 portable missile launcher]] which was favored by drivers with a penchant for explosive damage.<ref name="Vehicles 30" /> Some AT-RT drivers also carried a bulky weapon<ref name="Tin ATRT" /> that was slung behind their backs when out of use.<ref name="SWE3" />

==History==
===Clone Wars===
[[File:Clone_Patrol_on_Cato_Neimoidia.jpg|thumb|right|200px|An AT-RT driver during the Battle of Cato Neimodia.]]
AT-RT drivers saw action<ref name="CW:TGoD" /> by [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]. In that year,<ref name="20BBYDate">''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Visual Guide: Updated and Expanded]]'' places ''[[The Gauntlet of Death]]'' between "[[Witches of the Mist]]" and "[[Overlords]]," which are both dated to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]] by {{FactFile2014|48|20 BBY 9-12|Ventress and the Nightsisters}} and {{FactFile2014|75|20 BBY 13-14|Anakin and the Force}} respectively.</ref> during the [[Battle of Rishi (Clone Wars)|Battle of Rishi]] against the Confederacy's [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] forces, where a single AT-RT driver was deployed with Green Company to reclaim the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] [[Exonium/Legends|exonium]] mines.<ref name="CW:TGoD" /> AT-RT drivers later saw service in opposing the Confederacy's [[Invasion of Tatooine]] and during the [[Battle of Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Battle of Cato Neimodia]]<ref name="BF:ES" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

During the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]], AT-RT drivers were active under the [[9th Assault Corps/Legends|9th Assault Corps']] 41st Elite Legion<ref name="Vehicles 30" /> and the 91st Recon Corps' Lightning Squadron.<ref name="GaW" /> AT-RT pilots also saw action during the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]], where they were led by [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]],<ref name="212th ATRT" /> In the wake of the Battle of Kashyyyk, as the clone army turned on its [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] as a result of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]], AT-RT Drivers searched for the surviving General [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] but failed to prevent his escape.<ref name="SWE3" />

===Rise of the Galactic Empire===
[[File:Dantooine_SoR.png|thumb|left|240px|Imperial AT-RT drivers invaded the planet Dantooine (pictured) in order to find and execute Falon Grey.]]
Following the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in 19 BBY,<ref name="SWE3" /> clone AT-RT drivers followed the order on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], where they helped [[Death/Legends|kill]] [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ferroda]].<ref name="BF:ES" /> Some AT-RT drivers were also present in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]], helping slaughter the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the temple alongside the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] and [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Vader]].<ref name="Vehicles 30" /> During Order 66, clone AT-RT drivers also directly assisted in the execution of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] on the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="SWE3 Comic">[[Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith 3|''Star Wars: Episode III — Revenge of the Sith'' 3]]</ref> Following the order, AT-RT pilots continued to help hunt down surviving [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on the planet, including Jedi Master [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], who evaded their search efforts and escaped off-world.<ref name="Vehicles 30" />

Between [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] and [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]],<ref name="ES Dating">The narration in the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo DS|Nintendo DS]] version of ''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]'' states that fifteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] have elapsed between the battle on [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] and [[X2]]'s meeting with [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]]. Their meeting occurs at a point before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], but after the [[Corellian Treaty|formation]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], which takes place in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Using simple math to deduct fifteen years from those two dates, an approximate time period between the years [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] and [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]] can be established for the events on Dantooine.</ref> after the [[Declaration of a New Order|rise]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the now Imperial AT-RT drivers participated in the [[Battle of Dantooine (Imperial Period)|Invasion of Dantooine]], an operation orchestrated in order to find and kill the fugitive [[Falon Grey]] during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].<ref name="BF:ES" />

==Behind the scenes==
AT-RT drivers first appeared, albeit unnamed, in {{Film|III}}, a [[2005]] film written and directed by [[George Lucas]].<ref name="SWE3" /> They were later identified in ''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]'', a reference book written by [[Trisha Biggar]] and published in the same year by [[Abrams Books]].<ref name="DaG:TCoSW">''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''</ref>
